functional.title: Verify API documentation page loads successfully with all sections visible
preconditions: User is logged in with a valid account that has documentation access permissions
API documentation has been published and is in 'Active' status
User is on the main application dashboard
Browser is a supported version (Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Edge 90+, Safari 14+)

steps.action: Navigate to the documentation section by clicking 'Documentation' in the main navigation menu
steps.expectedResult: Documentation landing page loads within 3 seconds, displaying a list of available documentation resources

steps.action: Click on the 'API Documentation' link or card from the documentation landing page
steps.expectedResult: API Documentation page loads successfully showing the table of contents on the left sidebar and the main content area on the right

steps.action: Verify the presence of all major API documentation sections: Overview, Authentication, Endpoints, Request/Response Formats, Error Codes, Rate Limiting, and Versioning
steps.expectedResult: All seven major sections are listed in the table of contents and each section heading is visible when scrolling through the page

steps.action: Click on the 'Endpoints' section in the table of contents
steps.expectedResult: Page scrolls smoothly to the Endpoints section, and the section is highlighted in the table of contents as the active section

steps.action: Verify that each endpoint entry includes HTTP method, URL path, description, request parameters, and example response
steps.expectedResult: Each endpoint is fully documented with HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) displayed in a colored badge, URL path, description text, parameter table, and a formatted JSON example response

postconditions: API documentation page remains loaded and fully navigable
User session is still active and authenticated
No console errors or broken resource links are present in the browser developer tools

functional.title: Verify User Guide page loads successfully with all chapters and subsections

steps.expectedResult: User Guide page loads successfully displaying a structured table of contents with chapters and subsections

steps.action: Click on the 'Getting Started' chapter to expand its subsections
steps.expectedResult: Subsections such as 'System Requirements', 'Installation', 'First Login', and 'Dashboard Overview' are displayed beneath the chapter heading

steps.action: Click on the 'First Login' subsection
steps.expectedResult: Page navigates to or scrolls to the 'First Login' content area, displaying step-by-step instructions with screenshots or illustrations

postconditions: User Guide page is fully rendered with all content sections accessible

steps.action: Click on the first search result item
steps.expectedResult: User is navigated directly to the relevant section of the API documentation with the search term highlighted or the section scrolled into view

steps.expectedResult: Search results display the specific endpoint documentation for '/api/v1/users' including its HTTP methods and description

negative.title: Verify search input handles special characters and potential XSS injection safely
preconditions: User is logged in and on the API Documentation page
Search functionality is available
Application has XSS protection mechanisms in place

steps.action: Type '<script>alert("XSS")</script>' into the search bar and press Enter
steps.expectedResult: The script tag is NOT executed. The search either sanitizes the input and shows 'No results found' or displays the escaped text as a literal string in the results. No JavaScript alert dialog appears

steps.action: Type '' into the search bar and press Enter
steps.expectedResult: The malicious HTML is not rendered. No image element is created and no JavaScript executes. Input is sanitized or escaped

steps.action: Type '" OR 1=1 --' (SQL injection attempt) into the search bar and press Enter
steps.expectedResult: The input is treated as a literal search string. No SQL injection occurs. Results show 'No results found' or the literal string is searched safely

steps.action: Type '{{constructor.constructor("return this")()}}' (template injection) into the search bar and press Enter
steps.expectedResult: The template injection attempt is not executed. Input is safely handled and no server-side template rendering occurs

steps.action: Inspect the page source to verify the search input is properly HTML-encoded in any displayed results
steps.expectedResult: Special characters are HTML-encoded (e.g., '<' becomes '<', '"' becomes '"') in the rendered page source

postconditions: No XSS, SQL injection, or template injection vulnerabilities are exploitable through the search functionality
Application remains stable and functional after malicious input attempts
Security events may be logged for suspicious input patterns
